purpose: Record the bounded Evidence Trust Plane, Documentation Truth, repository-provider security-preservation, explicit bypass-intent semantics, Cloudflare remote-read MCP operator invariants, current test-discovery ratchet, and read-only provider-routed PR truth audit invariants for this candidate without claiming durable receipt persistence beyond existing external MCP evidence, live provider mutation, merge authority, deployment authority, secret installation, or live production truth.

claims: src/evidence/evidenceLifecycle.ts: evidence authority must fail closed at use time when a receipt is expired, stale, superseded, unledgered, rejected, or not bound through GitHub API readback to an exact repository, full SHA, workflow, and run identity; a receipt may prepare review but can never authorize merge, deploy, production promotion, secret changes, policy changes, or deletion by itself.

public/control-room/evidence-trust.html: the founder-facing Evidence Trust Plane must describe durable receipt storage as not wired by this slice, preserve observation versus verification versus authority boundaries, and keep evidence-state, may-unlock, and still-blocked labels available on mobile instead of presenting contract-only capability as implemented persistence.

.github/workflows/playwright.yml: the exact-head Playwright lane must execute the Evidence Trust Plane desktop and mobile proof when this authority surface changes; browser rendering proof remains non-authorizing and cannot prove provider mutation, durable persistence, merge authority, deployment authority, or production truth.

scripts/verify-documentation-truth.mjs: Documentation Truth must classify the Evidence Trust Plane source, founder-facing page, and Playwright authority workflow as evidence-authority truth-sensitive paths so architecture changes cannot false-green with zero truth-sensitive files; changing this verifier remains truth-governance and requires the corresponding current documentation refresh.

scripts/verify-test-discovery.mjs: the test-discovery ratchet must recognize both the reviewed legacy __tests__ pattern used by its adversarial fixtures and the current repository-wide supported JavaScript/TypeScript test-and-spec pattern recorded by scripts/test-discovery-baseline.json; candidate test-like filenames are detected case-insensitively for safety, but default-discovery matching is case-sensitive to mirror the actual Vitest glob, so a path such as src/example.TEST.ts cannot be falsely reported as executed; the baseline remains zero hidden tests and a candidate PR cannot create new hidden-test debt.

src/providers/SecurityPreservingGitHubProvider.ts: existing non-FCR ruleset reconciliation MUST preserve the stronger current enforcement level and MUST NOT demote an active or evaluate ruleset when a narrower caller requests weaker enforcement.

src/providers/SecurityPreservingGitHubProvider.ts: existing non-FCR ruleset reconciliation MUST union existing included branch refs with requested refs and MUST preserve existing excluded refs so a caller cannot silently narrow the provider-owned protected scope.

src/providers/SecurityPreservingGitHubProvider.ts: omitted bypassActors MUST preserve the current provider bypass posture, an explicit empty bypassActors list MUST clear all provider bypass actors, and a non-empty replacement MUST fail closed until a separately authorized provider-aware contract can represent bypass mode and prove the replacement is non-widening; this source contract does not itself prove live provider state.

src/http/routes/projects.ts: the founder ruleset route MUST preserve the semantic difference between an omitted bypassActors field and an explicit empty array so non-FCR provider reconciliation can distinguish preserve-current from clear-all intent; the route remains founder-authenticated and reservation/idempotency guarded before provider mutation.

src/providers/providerFactory.ts: all GitHub repository-provider construction, including bounded PR audit evidence, must remain behind LazyRepositoryProvider and the canonical provider factory so MCP callers cannot construct host SDK clients or mint provider credentials directly; GitHub App credential preference, FCR constitutional governance checks, exact reviewed base/head freshness membranes, and unchanged GitLab behavior remain authoritative.

src/providers/providerFactory.ts: the optional auditPullRequestEvidence capability must be proxied through the same governance project-ID mapping as other repository reads and must fail closed when a configured provider does not implement bounded pull-request evidence.

src/providers/RepositoryProvider.ts: bounded pull-request audit evidence is an optional provider-neutral read capability; consumers must fail closed when unsupported, and the capability carries no merge, approval, mutation, or provider-credential authority.

src/providers/PullRequestAuditEvidence.ts: the provider-neutral PR audit contract separates initial/final PR observations from bounded checks, workflow runs, review events, and changed-file metadata, with explicit completeness and observed/total-count fields so provider truncation cannot be silently promoted into complete evidence.

src/providers/GitHubAuditRepositoryProvider.ts: GitHub-specific PR audit API access lives inside the repository-provider family and reuses the canonical provider token/configuration; it may perform only bounded read observations for PR state, exact-head checks/workflows, reviews, and metadata-only changed files, with no new mutation authority.

src/providers/GitHubAuditRepositoryProvider.ts: checks/workflows propagate provider total counts, changed-file completeness is bound to the provider-reported PR file count, and review histories over 100 events use bounded first-plus-newest-page reads while remaining explicitly incomplete so neither API/memory use nor stale oldest-page approval can false-green the audit.

src/providers/rulesetSecurityMerge.ts: narrowing requested required-status contexts may remove unrequested check contexts but must not silently weaken stronger existing pull-request protections, deletion/non-fast-forward rules, unmanaged provider security rules, or retained status-check provider metadata for contexts that remain requested.

wrangler.worker.toml: the canonical Worker must bind FCR_REMOTE_MCP_READ_PROJECTS only to chief-ai-machine,founder-control-room and must require FCR_REMOTE_MCP_READ_TOKEN as a secret name without committing a secret value; this source wiring cannot prove the secret is installed or that the live /mcp/read endpoint is reachable.

src/providers/GitHubPrTruthReader.ts: the MCP-facing GitHub PR truth adapter must not import Octokit, accept or return provider credentials, or mint GitHub authentication; it may only request bounded PR audit evidence from the configured RepositoryProvider and remains hard-scoped in v0 to founder-control-room / jussray/founder-control-room.

src/mcp/github-truth/verification.ts: the composite audit must bind CI evidence to the initially observed PR head, treat any bounded-collection truncation as evidence_incomplete, and compare all load-bearing PR truth after evidence collection so a moving head, base, state, draft, mergeability, or equivalent authority-bearing change can never be promoted into current evidence or merge approval.

src/mcp/github-truth/verification.ts: a current known CI failure must outrank simultaneous pending CI signals; approvals recorded against an older commit SHA must not count as current approval; evidence_complete remains a completeness classification only and never means safe-to-merge; the summary must use the final PR observation when the two reads differ.
